sections.title: Local Historical Reader
sections.text: fmcad batch summary --report-path DIR [--step N] [--json] reads the latest numerically numbered immutable report (version-1 non-atomic or version-2 atomic) in a contiguous history starting at 00000000.json. No --doc, config or backend is needed; no replay, mutation, lock acquisition or model validation occurs. Relative DIR resolves from CLI cwd. Stale run.lock and publisher temporary files are ignored and retained. A running snapshot is valid historical evidence and may include pending/running steps; it is not completed success. Missing directories/reports, history gaps, corrupt latest JSON/schema/hash and invalid steps throw ERROR with nonzero exit; there is no fallback to an older successful report.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: TEXT shows historical reported status, runId, resolved reportPath and per-step number/id/status/error. --step is a 1-based positive integer, preserves the original step number, rejects 0/out-of-range, and filters only steps, never the stored overall outcome. --json returns {operation:batch.summary,historical:true,modelValidated:false,success,status,runId,reportPath,sequence,steps:[{step,id,status,result?,error?}]}. result optionally contains present scalar/null value, units, count, healthy, healthState, passed, sampledPassed and checkOutcome (strings up to 256 characters); absent fields are omitted, not zero. success/status are stored run outcomes, not read success or model acceptance. Failed/unknown/running history has success:false and exits 1; successful history exits 0 without certifying current Fusion state. No full outputs are returned by this reader; numbered snapshots retain them.

examples.label: Inspect one historical step
examples.requires: Existing local batch report history; no Fusion connection.
examples.output: Historical summary of step 1 with stored overall success/status and modelValidated:false.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: On structural failure: success:false, errors:string[], limitations:string[], operation:batch.validate, mode:validate, mutated:false; operations/checks may be absent if initial clone/expansion failed. On a completed structural check: also operations (expanded ordered steps, refs remain symbolic) and checks:string[]. Returns the same schema on success with errors:[]; no request hash, lock or report files. Inputs and nested step/ref/parameter contracts are detailed in Step schema/Parameter substitution below; no additional nested keys are accepted. The unconditional CLI --doc requirement remains even though no document is contacted.

examples.label: Validate an empty-input read step
examples.requires: None beyond CLI installation. --doc Model is syntactically required but Model need not exist for validate.
examples.output: success:true, operations with unchanged data, checks and limitations, mode:validate, mutated:false. No entities are queried.

verified: all top-level/step keys and reserved identifiers
failure/success return branches and offline boundary

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Same structural validation schema as batch validate with operation:batch.preview and mode:preview: success, errors, operations (after literal parameter expansion), checks, limitations, mutated:false. Early clone/parameter failures may omit operations/checks. References are NOT resolved against fictional outputs. reportPath is accepted but never read/written in preview. No backend/config initialization or model feasibility checks.

examples.label: Inspect literal expansion
examples.requires: No Fusion connection. Name existence and component creation prerequisites are intentionally not tested.
examples.output: operations[0].data.name is Bracket; mutated:false. This does not create a component or check name collisions.

verified: all nested schema via shared validator

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: A new run report contains version:1, success:boolean, operation:batch.run, runId, requestHash, request (original JSON minus mode/reportPath), context:{doc,component,projectId,preview,docId?,docFileId?}, status:running|success|failed|unknown, createdAt/updatedAt ISO timestamps, sequence:integer, reportPath:absolute CLI-host directory, limitations/checks:string[], steps:array. Optional identity pins are retained in context and its hash; formatting flags are not. Each step starts {id,operation,status:pending}; before execution gets mutationStatus:none (declared readOnly) or unknown, request:{operation,data,context}; successful return records output:the full CAD envelope and mutationStatus:none|completed. Failed returned evidence records output/error; thrown exceptions have status:unknown,error:{message,code?},timeout:boolean and may have no output. Unresolved refs have status:failed,mutationStatus:not_started,error. Following steps become skipped. Entire-run success is true only after all steps succeed. Replay returns saved report plus replayed:true and resolved reportPath without re-executing. Invalid schema returns validation schema instead of a report; locking/history/hash/filesystem errors throw and CLI prints ERROR. Creation of report directories can occur before later replay refusal. Data/context are cloned before async work; no live model ID is verified by report hashing. Step component:null is accepted and resets live CAD context to root; absent component inherits outer context. Other resolved component types are not validated offline.

examples.label: Record and optionally replay a read-only inspection
examples.requires: An open uniquely named Model and configured backend for run. Use a fresh local report directory or an exactly matching successful saved report. Offline --preview does not create it.
examples.output: steps[0].output.result.entities contains actual discovered bodies. Re-running exactly the same request/context reuses the local report only; it is not a fresh inspection. Use a new report/run identity when fresh observation is required.

verified: step scope and output paths in worked six-step example
bugs: Replay verifies local request/context/history, not actual Fusion document identity/state; replacing a document under the same name is undetected.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Delegates to the SAME batch validator/runner and then sets returned operation to definition.instantiate. mode defaults to run only when absent; validate/preview produce the validation schema with mutated:false. Explicit mode must be exactly validate, preview or run. Invalid values, including null, false, 0 and empty string, are rejected before config/backend initialization or report access, even with --preview. Use --preview to force the offline path for valid inputs. Run reports retain all batch progress, requestHash, steps/output and conservative replay rules; persisted snapshots use operation:batch.run while the returned outer result is labeled definition.instantiate. parameters are literal JSON definitions, not automatically created Fusion parameters. Substitution transforms operations only, clones whole values, does not recursively interpret a $param introduced inside a replacement (remaining markers fail validation), does not interpolate strings or evaluate code. A parameter value containing a sole-key $ref can intentionally produce a normal backward result reference during validation.

examples.label: Define parameterized dimensions as an offline payload
examples.requires: No Fusion for mode preview. To execute, explicitly change mode to run (or remove it), verify Model and name/helper availability, and review shape box prerequisites.
examples.output: operation:definition.instantiate, mode:preview, operations[0].data.width is 40 mm. An executed shape recipe retains its own dimension equations; definition expansion itself stores no Fusion parameter.

verified: mode selection and returned versus persisted operation
invalid mode rejected before config/backend/report access even with --preview

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: reportPath is a required existing numbered atomic report directory on the CLI machine (created by batch run atomic). operations is an optional array of at most 100 {operation,data} entries, each an existing read-only CAD handler (catalog readOnly:true); these are observation requests, not mutations. The CLI shorthand --data observe means an empty observation list. Reconcile never opens or activates a document, never writes the report, never removes a lock, and never replays; identity ambiguity is reported, never resolved by opening.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns {operation:batch.reconcile, runId, requestHash?, outcome, status, receiptOutcome?, nativeOutcome?, observation:{status,destroyed?,completed?,cleanupCompleted?}, observed?, candidates, unavailableEvidence}. outcome is committed/aborted only when the durable report already recorded that terminal outcome; otherwise unknown. nativeOutcome is populated only when the live holder was observed destroyed. status is one of not_submitted, unavailable, identity_mismatch, ambiguous, receipt_mismatch, or the observed status. observed holds the read-only handler outputs; these are observations, not native acceptance.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Read-only inspection of the receipt and the matching live holder; identity checks use exact commandId/runId/requestHash/backend/sessionNonce/documentIdentity, and any mismatch keeps outcome unknown. It never activates or opens a document to resolve ambiguity, never steals a writer lock, and never issues a restore or replay RPC. Without a reliable terminal result the outcome remains unknown even if the holder was lost.

examples.label: Identity-only reconcile
examples.requires: An existing atomic batch run report directory; the addin backend with atomicBatch capability is configured. This sends read-only holder inspection only.
examples.output: outcome reflects the durable report (committed/aborted) or unknown; status/observation report the live holder state without opening the document.

examples.label: Bounded read-only observations
examples.requires: The same report directory; at most 100 operations, each an existing read-only CAD handler. Observed outputs are not acceptance.
examples.output: result.observed lists the read-only handler outputs; outcome remains committed/aborted/unknown as recorded.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: reportPath is a required existing numbered atomic report directory. finalize cleans up only the exact owned native command (commandId/runId/requestHash/backend/sessionNonce/documentIdentity from the receipt). It requires the addin atomicBatch capability; it never opens or activates a document, never restarts/cancels/replays, and never removes another writer's lock.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns {operation:batch.finalize, outcome, status, cleanupCompleted, nativeOutcome?, receiptOutcome?, publication?}. status is blocked/identity_mismatch/ambiguous/receipt_mismatch/already_finalized/publication_failed/finalized. cleanupCompleted is true only after the owned command definition was deleted and its handlers released. already_finalized is returned when the report already carries a finalize_ack journal with cleanupCompleted:true and a committed/aborted outcome; a known committed outcome is never reset.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Idempotent for the exact owned command. It proceeds only after the live holder is observed destroyed, the command context is idle, and the receipt/holder identity matches exactly; a present writer lock (run.lock) refuses finalize without lock theft. A failed publication of the finalize_ack journal keeps cleanupCompleted true with a publication_failed status; outcome is never upgraded to complete and unresolved outcomes stay unknown.

examples.label: Finalize an owned atomic command
examples.requires: An existing atomic batch run report directory; addin backend with atomicBatch capability; the owned command was observed destroyed and the context is idle.
examples.output: status finalized with cleanupCompleted:true and nativeOutcome committed/aborted; already_finalized if the ack already exists.
